correctness.rationale: PASS. The indexed double-involute map reduces on the 3-periodic center vertices to a row-stochastic 3x3 matrix T. The two half-sum involutes give T_ij = rho delta_ij+(1-rho)w_j with rho=xyz/(4abc), x=b+c-a, y=c+a-b, z=a+b-c, and w=(b y^2,c z^2,a x^2)/(4abc-xyz). This fixes O=Σw_j M_j, multiplies all two independent differences by rho at every double step, and AM--GM yields 0<rho≤1/4, equality exactly x=y=z. The x=y=1,z∈(0,1] path realizes the full range.
residual_risks: Source indexing conventions are essential: relabel the second involute exactly; applying a different polygonal involute does not inherit the formula.
No assertion for degenerate determinant-triangle boundary or polygons with more than three opposing edge pairs.
